mapper.select:
SELECT t.id,t.name,t.major,t.classHours,t.experimentType,t.intro,t.update_time, l.id as laboratory_id ,l.name as laboratory_name FROM training t LEFT JOIN laboratory l ON t.laboratory_id = l.id WHERE (l.id IS NULL OR t.laboratory_id = l.id)
and t.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training(name, major, classHours, experimentType, courseSpecific, certificationMapping, competitionMapping, relatedTrainingResources, intro, laboratory_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{major}, #{classHours}, #{experimentType}, #{courseSpecific}, #{certificationMapping}, #{competitionMapping}, #{relatedTrainingResources}, #{intro}, #{laboratory_id}, #{create_time}, #{update_time})
mapper.update: UPDATE training SET name=#{name}, major=#{major}, classHours=#{classHours}, experimentType=#{experimentType}, courseSpecific=#{courseSpecific}, certificationMapping=#{certificationMapping}, competitionMapping=#{competitionMapping}, relatedTrainingResources=#{relatedTrainingResources}, intro=#{intro}, laboratory_id=#{laboratory_id}, update_time=#{update_time} WHERE id=#{id}
